subject: SDLC preflight: CI token stewardship & PR gating evidence
messages:
From: Grace Thomas <grace.thomas@orangebank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security-assessor@orangebank.com, procurement@orangebank.com
Date: 2029-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SDLC preflight evidence request — OrangeBank assessment

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for taking our call earlier. Our internal security team needs a concise evidence bundle to verify a few Secure SDLC controls for our SIG/SOC2 review. Specifically were looking for the following:  

- CI token lifecycle proof: rotation schedule, sample rotation logs, and any short-lived credential policies.
- PR gating: screenshot of branch protection rules, the PR checklist automation, and a note on who can bypass.
- Code review: example diffs showing reviewer approvals and required checks, and your process for mandatory reviewers for sensitive repos.

Can you provide a package (zipped) or links to the artifacts by EOD Friday (2029-05-03 PST)? If timeline is tight, even a short preflight that points to the canonical artifacts is fine.

Appreciate it — Grace

--
Grace Thomas
Security Operations, OrangeBank
grace.thomas@orangebank.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Grace Thomas <grace.thomas@orangebank.com>
Cc: security-assessor@orangebank.com
Date: 2029-05-03T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC preflight evidence request — OrangeBank assessment

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the list. We can assemble a focused preflight bundle that covers CI token rotation, PR gating, and sample code-review traces. Ill pull the logs and screenshots and send a zipped bundle. Quick notes:  

- CI tokens: we use ephemeral CI tokens for runners (14-hour TTL) plus automated rotation for service account keys; I will include an anonymized rotation log and the runbook excerpt.
- PR gating: branch protection enforces linear history + required status checks; bypass is limited to a delegated release group (names redacted in public artifacts). Will include a screenshot and the repo-level policy export.
- Code review: will attach a redacted patch showing approvals and required checks.

Looping in Jordan and Mateo to pull the logs & patch; Irene, can you export the branch protection policy for core repos?

Ill aim to send the first bundle within a few hours and a final package by EOD.

Best,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: 2029-05-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: ACTION: Pull artifacts for OrangeBank preflight (see Grace below)

Team,

Grace at OrangeBank asked for a minimal evidence bundle for their SIG/SOC2 preflight. Please pull/provide the following artifacts by EOD:  

Jordan: provide the anonymized CI token rotation log (showing timestamps, rotated key IDs, and rotation trigger). Save as ci-token-rotation-sample.log and strip any live secrets.

Mateo: capture a code-review example for repo "model-serving" — include the PR description, reviewer approvals, and status checks. Produce a patch file sample-code-review-diffs.patch and a short plain-text narrative of the gating conditions.

Irene: export branch-protection policy for core repos and screenshots of the UI policy (pr-gating-policy-screenshot.png). Note any repo-specific overrides.

When you have everything, bundle into redwood_sdlc_preflight_pack_v1.zip and upload to the shared drive link below. Keep content redacted per privacy policy; we only need metadata and proof-of-process.

Thanks — Hannah

(Quoted)
> From: Grace Thomas <grace.thomas@orangebank.com>
> Date: 2029-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
> Subject: SDLC preflight evidence request — OrangeBank assessment
> 
> [see original request]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Grace Thomas <grace.thomas@orangebank.com>
Cc: security-assessor@orangebank.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2029-05-06T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SDLC preflight evidence request — OrangeBank assessment (package attached)

Hi Grace — attaching the preflight bundle we discussed. High-level summary included below for your assessor. If you need additional artifacts (longer logs, full policy exports) we can provide them under an NDA or via your secure S3 transfer.

Attachments (in ZIP):
- redwood_sdlc_preflight_pack_v1.zip (contains the files listed below)
  - ci-token-rotation-sample.log  — anonymized rotation records (timestamps, key IDs, rotate_reason); no secrets included.
  - pr-gating-policy-screenshot.png — branch protection screenshot from the org settings.
  - sample-code-review-diffs.patch — redacted diff showing approval flow and required checks.
  - README_preflight.txt — short README explaining folder contents and where to request deeper artifacts.

Quick pointers:  
- Token policy: CI runner tokens issued with 14-hour TTL; service account keys rotated every 30 days by our key-management job; emergency rotations are logged and require release-manager approval.
- PR gating: required checks (unit-tests, lint, security-scan) must pass; protected branches require at least one senior reviewer, and bypass is limited to the ReleaseOps group and requires audit entries.
- Code review: we enforce mandatory reviewers on critical repos; patch demonstrates required approval and the status-check gating sequence.

Links:  
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-preflight
- Runbook excerpt: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/CI+Token+Rotation+Runbook

If youd like a short walkthrough with the assessor this week, Jordan and I can join a 30-minute call.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment stubs: redwood_sdlc_preflight_pack_v1.zip (application/zip), ci-token-rotation-sample.log (text/plain), pr-gating-policy-screenshot.png (image/png), sample-code-review-diffs.patch (text/x-patch)
